acceptance: git grep "ToolOutputFiles()\\[" finds no test that indexes the list by position
A test reorders the list (through the accessor source) and the four tests still check the same files
go test -count=1 -race passes for gcpolicy, core, ciparitygate and ship
fix: Give gcpolicy a named accessor for each tool output file (or a lookup by writer name), and change all four tests to use it. Keep ToolOutputFiles for the callers that need the whole list.
summary: The architecture review of PR 1789 (log retention follow-ups) found index-coupled assertions on gcpolicy.ToolOutputFiles(). Four tests read the list by position: go/internal/phases/audit/ciparitygate/tier_test.go:395 ([1]), go/internal/phases/ship/repocontract_output_test.go:107 ([0]), go/internal/core/tool_output_retention_test.go:99 ([0]) and go/internal/core/tool_output_retention_cover_test.go:17 ([0]). The order of that list is not part of its contract, so a reorder or an insert breaks the tests or, worse, makes them check the wrong file.
title: Tests of gcpolicy.ToolOutputFiles assert by name, not by slice position
